svg.title: Peaks are cut before you hear them
svg.desc: Two waveforms: without the limiter, red spikes cross the dashed ceiling; with Decibel Limiter, the orange waveform stays under −20 dBFS.
svg.text: Peaks are cut before you hear them.
Audio is held for ~10 ms, so the volume is already down when the loud part arrives —
no blast first, then a late duck.
Same audio, held under your ceiling
